GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
APO 500
MEMORANDUM
30 September 1949
SUBJECT: Information of General Application Pertaining to Directive Number SCAPIN 2048, file AG 000.91 (21 Sep 48)CCS, this Headquarters, dated 30 September 49 , subject: Ionosphere Measurements and Associated Research in Japan
1. With reference to the subject memorandum the following is published for information for all concerned.
2. SCAPIN 1936 was issued shortly after the beginning of the Occupation in order to insure the continuation of Japanese ionosphere observations and related research activities which were considered vital to military and commercial communications. Since the SCAP policy in existence at that time did not permit the use of radar principles required in making these observations, it was necessary to issue the proper authorization.
3. Present SCAP policy is such that the use of these radar principles for ionosphere observations and related research activities are in the authorized category and therefore the authority contained in SCAPIN 1936 is no longer necessary.
4. It is not anticipated that the rescission of this SCAPIN will in any way alter the activities of the Japanese in making measurements as originally required and which are useful to both Japan and other nations in the conduct of radio communications.
5. The rescission of SCAPIN 1936 is considered advisable in light of the policy to return as much authority as possible to the Japanese.
A J REHE
Major, AGD
Asst Adj Gen
